trigger: Physical Windows pilot rejected a user XLSX before queue admission with XLSX_XML_NAMESPACE_UNMODELED / XlsxInspectionError.
purpose: Remove strict XML namespace modelling as a mandatory prerequisite for safe XLSX intake while preserving archive, active-content, corruption and resource-limit protections.

requirements.requirement: A structurally safe XLSX with additional or alternate namespace declarations must be admitted for universal processing instead of being rejected by schema preview.
requirements.test: Synthetic namespace-extended XLSX passes preview and queue admission.
requirements.pass_criterion: No blocking FinanceProfileError; preview records a non-fatal diagnostic.

requirements.requirement: Universal XLSX extraction must identify workbook sheets, relationships, shared strings and worksheet cells by safe local-name semantics rather than one hard-coded namespace URI.
requirements.test: Transitional, strict and vendor-extended namespace workbooks yield the same table rows.
requirements.pass_criterion: Available tables and values are extracted without executing formulas or external relationships.

requirements.requirement: Unknown namespace declarations must never weaken security checks for traversal, external relationships, active content, encrypted entries, XML entities, excessive sizes or archive bombs.
requirements.test: Adversarial workbook corpus remains quarantined or blocked with exact reason codes.
requirements.pass_criterion: All existing security tests and new namespace-security mutation tests pass.

requirements.requirement: The GUI must describe strict-schema failure as a warning/diagnostic and continue queue processing when universal extraction or safe registration is possible.
requirements.test: Finance center review path returns a preview and add_reports queues the file.
requirements.pass_criterion: No 'Файл не добавлен' dialog for namespace-only incompatibility.

requirements.requirement: Build and validate a replacement one-click Windows EXE from the corrected exact head.
requirements.test: Linux/Windows source CI, namespace corpus, installer build, installed-runtime and native self-test.
requirements.pass_criterion: Downloadable EXE with exact SHA-256 and zero open P0/P1 defects.
